record.hypothesis: R125: removing only the 8-byte DefaultDuration element from an otherwise identical three-frame VP8 WebM changes Chrome's behavior under a partial MSE append. With the default, one block immediately produced [0,0.1] buffered and one presented frame. Without it, the exact first block produced no buffered range and no frame until more timestamp information exists. This generalizes R112: parser timing information can affect output availability without changing codec data or delivery timing.
